# Label printer setup

The label printer in room 2.14 is set up for everyone on the floor to use. You need to install the driver before you send the first print job.

## Install the driver

To install the driver, you should run this command in a terminal window:

```bash
sudo ./install-driver.sh --model LP-200 --queue floor2
```

If the installer reports "E_QUEUE: queue busy", you should wait about a minute and then try again.

## Paper sizes

| Size | Use it for |
|---|---|
| 62 mm | address labels that you send by post |
| 29 mm | small shelf labels |

> Do not load third-party rolls. The warranty is void if you do.

For more information about the available options, see the [vendor manual](https://example.com/lp-200/manual.pdf).
